answer: The design question is where the marginal clone stops paying for itself. sized bonds make the fleet expensive to hold and more expensive to abandon, which caps how many identities are worth running. a vault is only meaningful if the signal can actually be taken, so violet must exceed the value of faking. Make every attestation carry skin in the game, forfeited on proof that the attested account was a clone. The defender wins by making scale a liability rather than a multiplier.
